description_en: This API uses the WebSocket protocol to perform real-time conversational transcription, intent recognition, and speech synthesis. It supports various audio formats for both input and output to ensure real-time performance and high compatibility
description_zh: 本接口通过 WebSocket 协议实现实时语音对话转写、意图识别、话术语音合成返回等功能，支持多种音频格式的输入输出，满足实时性与高兼容性需求
name: EndToEndRealTimeDialog

parameters.help_en: The ID of the speech recognition model. The default value is nls-base. Supported models include paraformer-realtime-v2 and paraformer-realtime-8k-v2
parameters.help_zh: 语音识别模型id。默认为nls-base。目前支持paraformer-realtime-v2、paraformer-realtime-8k-v2等
parameters.name: asr_model_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the speech synthesis model. The default value is nls-base. The cosyvoice-v2 model is supported
parameters.help_zh: 语音合成模型id。默认为nls-base。支持cosyvoice-v2
parameters.name: tts_model_id

parameters.help_en: The input audio format. Supported formats are pcm, wav, and mp3
parameters.name: input_format

parameters.help_en: The voice parameter. This is available only for models that support word-level or sentence-level timestamps
parameters.help_zh: 音色参数值，仅限于支持字/句级别时间戳
parameters.name: voice_code

parameters.help_en: The volume. The value ranges from 0 to 100. This parameter is optional. The default value is 50
parameters.name: volume

parameters.help_en:
The speech rate.
● If \`ttsModelId\` is \`nls-base\`: The value ranges from -500 to 500. The default is 0.
● If \`ttsModelId\` is \`cosyvoice-v2\`:
Specifies the speech rate of the synthesized audio. The value ranges from 0.5 to 2.
○ 0.5: Half the default speed.
○ 1: The default speed. The default speed is the model's standard output speed and may vary slightly by speaker. It is about four characters per second.
○ 2: Twice the default speed
parameters.help_zh:
朗读语速。
● 当ttsModelId为nls-base时：范围是-500~500，默认是0。
● 当ttsModelId为cosyvoice-v2时：
指定合成音频的语速，取值范围：0.5~2。
  ○ 0.5：表示默认语速的0.5倍速。
  ○ 1：表示默认语速。默认语速是指模型默认输出的合成语速，语速会因发音人不同而略有不同。约每秒钟4个字。
  ○ 2：表示默认语速的2倍速
parameters.name: speech_rate

parameters.help_en:
The pitch rate.
● If \`ttsModelId\` is \`nls-base\`:
The value ranges from -500 to 500. The default is 0.
● If \`ttsModelId\` is \`cosyvoice-v2\`: Specifies the pitch of the synthesized audio. The value ranges from 0.5 to 2
parameters.help_zh:
朗读语调。
● 当ttsModelId为nls-base时：
范围是-500~500，默认是0。
● 当ttsModelId为cosyvoice-v2时：指定合成音频的语调，取值范围：0.5~2
parameters.name: pitch_rate
